title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of Whether Property Losses in Traffic Accidents Include the Loss of Operation of Damaged Vehicles

articles.content_en:
Higher People's Court of Jilin Province:
We have received your Request for Instructions on Whether Property Loss in Traffic Accident Damage Compensation Includes Indirect Loss (Ji Gao Fa [1998] No. 143). Upon study, our reply is as follows:
Article 117, paragraphs 2 and 3 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China provide: 'Anyone who damages state, collective property or the property of another person shall restore the property to its original condition or compensate for the loss.' 'If the victim suffers other major losses as a result, the infringer shall compensate for such losses as well.' Therefore, in a traffic accident damage compensation case, if the victim claims compensation for the loss of business income during the repair period on the ground that the damaged vehicle was being used for cargo or passenger transport operations, the person liable for the traffic accident shall compensate for such losses.
Reply herewith.
